postDeployRecommendations.message: The API ships with a `MOCK_AUTH_SECRET` + `postMockToken` endpoint intended for local development only. Replace with Entra ID (Static Web Apps built-in auth or App Service Easy Auth) before public exposure.

Postgres Flexible Server is provisioned with public network access + firewall rules for demo simplicity. For production, switch to Private Access (VNet-integrated) and reach it from the Function App via VNet integration.

No test suites or CI/CD workflow files present. Add smoke tests (services/attendance-api/scripts/smoke.mjs already exists — automate) and a GitHub Actions workflow calling `az deployment sub create` + SWA CLI on push.
Attach a custom domain to Static Web Apps and configure Front Door / SWA linked backend if you want the API served from the same origin.
